summary.name: Wink
summary.one_liner: Wink is a Meitu-made AI tool for restoring image and video quality and retouching portraits, offered as a mobile app, a PC client and a web version.
use_cases: Restore blurry screenshots or old photos
Upscale low-resolution videos to clearer quality
Retouch portraits and apply beauty effects to video
Remove watermarks from images and videos
Repair ID photos that fail quality requirements
Enhance concert, product, anime or game images
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Wink as an AI image and video repair tool with scene-specific restoration for portraits, concerts, product images, anime and games. The PC client is described as a desktop AI video editor, and it lists functions such as image quality repair, super resolution, noise removal, watermark removal, AI colour grading, AI erase, video frame interpolation, video dehaze and old photo restoration. Portrait tools include facial feature adjustment, eye-light addition, teeth whitening, automatic face detection for multi-person shots, and applying different beauty effects to different video segments. A command-line Skill can be installed with npx to let an AI agent run quality repair on images.
notable: Scene-specific quality repair (portrait, concert, product, anime, game)
Installable Skill via npx github:meitu/wink-cli for AI agents (requires Wink PC V3.8.0+)
Per-segment beauty effects on video with automatic multi-face detection
Broad input format support including RAW and video formats like MKV, AVI, MOV
caveats: VIP and SVIP tiers differ in device access, batch limits, cloud processing duration and daily free cloud quota
Cloud processing sends photos to cloud models for deeper processing
Some features and materials are restricted to paid VIP/SVIP tiers
